about: Echoes of Cargo 1 in 2460: every flag Cargo 1 carries to Cargo 2 is read here or elsewhere (rumours, and three old acquaintances).

meza_voce.about: head of the Rootstock family, forty years on

pirate_captain.about: founder of the Void Angels, if she was spared; old, still flies point

echo.aela_leased.text: At the Rockwarden claim the old mining agrobot is still leased equipment, forty years on. It asks every visiting captain whether leases ever expire.

echo.aela_member.text: The Rockwarden cooperative's first machine shareholder, an old mining agrobot, has not missed a meeting in forty years. It votes against overtime, every time.

echo.asked_the_garrison.text: The garrison at Scholz's Star still guards something under the ice. A captain once asked what, the rumour goes, and the Mandate has kept a file on that captain ever since.

echo.bought_the_vote.text: The old haulers say the vote that made the Mark law was bought. They say it fondly, the way people talk about a grandparent who smuggled.

echo.carried_concertina.text: Concertina still tours. She tells every audience about the hauler who flew her to her first gala at Epsilon in a cargo hold, in a ballgown.

echo.carried_the_pilgrims.text: The Cult of the Broken Machine keeps a list of the ships that carried its pilgrims. One of them is near the top, in gold leaf.

echo.carried_the_samples.text: The builders' metal sits in a case in the Stellar Institute's lobby, labelled with the ship that hauled it. The label says the builders were unknown. It has not been changed.

echo.defied_serac.text: {serac} keeps two lists, they say. One of the captains who owe him, and a shorter one.

echo.delivered_the_hovertank.text: The legion's hovertank still stands guard at Delta c, forty years after a hauler delivered it. The colonists put flowers on it.

echo.fed_gamma.text: Gamma's miners still tell how a hauler brought food down the shafts when the company would not.

echo.fluencer_exposed.text: Brisa still streams, and still claims a Neon family. Her viewers know better; a hauler told her so, live, forty years ago, and the clip still circulates.

echo.fluencer_streamed.text: A forty-year-old stream of a hauler's cockpit still has nine million views. Haulers' children watch it for the dials.

echo.found_the_chair.text: Whoever set the Institute fire forty years ago never stood trial. A captain knows whose security firm it was, the rumour says, and has never said.

echo.grey_hats_client.text: The Grey Hats still clean records, and keep a ledger of every record they cleaned. Somebody's name is in it from forty years back.

echo.heard_the_warning.text: 'Make sure it starts from home,' an older captain said at a portal forty years ago. The Concord's archivists are still arguing about what it meant.

echo.knows_the_quartermaster.text: The quartermaster who sold the convoys forty years ago retired rich and died rich. One captain knew who; the Hansa never asked.

echo.krog_aboard.text: A KRO-series loader named Krogg still rides with one hauler, watching where the crates go. It has opinions about stowage, and about that hauler.

echo.legion_freelance.text: The Mandate's recruiters keep a list of captains who turned down every legion's commission. They still send a letter every year.

echo.legion_omnicorp.text: OmniCorp's old legion is a Mandate wing now. Its veterans still salute each other in the corporate colours, quietly.

echo.legion_stellar.text: Stellar Dynamics' old legion is a Mandate wing now. Its veterans still meet once a year and argue about who had the better guns.

echo.legion_xylo.text: The Xylo Consortium's old legion is a Mandate wing now. Its veterans still wear the green, under the grey.

echo.lot77_bought.text: The Unsorted, the robots who belong to nothing, still repair one hauler's ship at cost, and nobody else's.

echo.manifest_completed.text: The Broken Machine's holy manifest was delivered at last, forty years late. The cult keeps the day with a reading of the cargo list.

echo.rockwarden_books.text: The Rockwarden cooperative still keeps its books in the hand of the hauler who kept them while Stonewright flew sublight.

echo.rockwarden_share.text: The Rockwarden cooperative still pays a dividend on one share held by a hauler. It has grown into a small fortune nobody collects.

echo.rostrom_declined.text: House Rostrom was nearly never founded: a hauler refused its first loan, and it had to find another. It has not forgotten which hauler.

echo.rostrom_paper.text: House Rostrom's first paper about the ring hangs framed in its hall. The names on it are the house's, and one is a hauler's.

echo.saved_level_nine.text: Twelve miners got out of level nine at Gamma forty years ago. Their grandchildren know the name of the ship that helped.

echo.solarian_friend.text: The Solarian reading-house still reads out its donors' names at the solstice. One of them is a hauler's.

echo.sold_the_hovertank.text: {serac}'s old depot still has the legion's prototype hovertank. It has been repainted four times and has never moved.

echo.tadeo_took_blame.text: A gunner took the blame for a sold convoy forty years ago and never said who sold it. He runs a bar at Alpha now.

echo.virtual_friend.text: A Neon heir in a holographic body still flies with one hauler only: the one who charged for the passenger, not the projector.

echo.worshipped.text: The Order of the Lost Gear still keeps a hauler's ship as a minor relic. Its pilgrims touch the hull at every dock.

rootstock.voce.title: A customs officer who is not
text: A customs officer at the gate stops your manifest, reads it twice, and asks whether a certain captain still flies. She is an android in a good suit, and she is not a customs officer.
{meza_voce} has run the Rootstock for forty years. The family is bigger now, and it feeds three systems the Hansa forgot.
A customs officer at the gate stops your manifest, reads it twice, and asks whether a certain captain still flies. She is an android in a good suit, and she is not a customs officer.
It is {meza_voce.short}. 'Family,' she says, and stamps the manifest without reading it. 'We kept your place at the table.'
A customs officer at the gate stops your manifest, reads it twice, and asks whether a certain captain still flies. She is an android in a good suit, and she is not a customs officer.
It is {meza_voce.short}. 'The garrison's exoskeletons,' she says. 'Our loaders still wear them. They fit well. Thank you.'
A customs officer at the gate stops your manifest, reads it twice, and asks whether a certain captain still flies. She is an android in a good suit, and she is not a customs officer.
It is {meza_voce.short}. 'You fed Gamma when the company would not,' she says. 'So did we. That makes us colleagues.'

choices.say: Take one of the family's runs (12,000)
Take your place at the table
Let her stamp the manifest and go

mraz.angels.title: The Void Angels
text: A ship with no transponder and very good paint falls in beside your needle: the Void Angels, the free captains of the outer lanes.
{pirate_captain} is old now and still flies point. She escaped the legion's prison in her second year. She remembers who put her there.
A ship with no transponder and very good paint falls in beside your needle: the Void Angels, the free captains of the outer lanes.
{pirate_captain} founded them, after a hauler let her go forty years ago. 'Same hauler,' she says on the channel. 'Fly with us a while.'
A ship with no transponder and very good paint falls in beside your needle: the Void Angels, the free captains of the outer lanes.
{pirate_captain} flew your escort forty years ago, for pay. 'The rate has gone up,' she says. 'For you, not much.'

choices.say: Let them fly escort to the next dock
Hire them for the next run (8,000)
Take what she has come to settle
Pay her for the prison years (15,000)
Wave and keep your place in the file

cargolytes.sect.title: Apparent good order
text: In the tail of the needle a Cargolyte stevedore comes over on a line, singing, with a copy of your manifest: 'In apparent good order and condition.'
The Cargolytes are a full sect now, with the Broken Machine as a branch. The Sixpack, their council, sends greetings to a captain from the old days, and a bill.

choices.say: Pay the tithe before they ask: a tenth of your fullest hold
Sing the receipt back to them
